properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored BearSSL ships 3DES-EDE-CBC suites in its "full" client/server profiles (ssl_client_full.c:91-94, ssl_server_full_ec.c:74-76, ssl_server_full_rsa.c:64-65) plus the brssl tool name table (names.c) and twrch.c test tool. Critically, the application's TLS adapter invokes these full profiles on every session (src/ssl/iwn_brssl_poller_adapter.c:610 client, :497 server), so 3DES-CBC is live-offered by this application's TLS endpoints. Sweet32-vulnerable 64-bit block cipher; broken classically,

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored BearSSL declares single-DES-CBC suite IDs (bearssl_ssl.h:1493/1511), ships a dedicated default single-DES-CBC record engine (ssl_engine_default_descbc.c:29/34) which the full profiles wire in via br_ssl_engine_set_default_des_cbc (ssl_client_full.c:177, server profiles), plus twrch.c test tool. 56-bit cipher, broken since the 1990s; the client full suite list itself omits single-DES suites, but the engine is compiled into the shipped library. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC suites throughout BearSSL's full profiles (ssl_client_full.c:63-88, server profiles) — live-offered by this application's TLS sessions via the adapter's init_full calls (iwn_brssl_poller_adapter.c:610/497); also the TLS key-export path (ssl_keyexport.c:33-36, RFC 5705/5705-style keying-material export using the negotiated session cipher) and the brssl name table. CBC-HMAC suites are legacy but not broken; quantum-safe under Grover with adequate key size. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 as used in the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD: implementations (poly1305_ctmul.c and variants), the chapol record layer (ssl_rec_chapol.c), engine default wiring (ssl_engine_default_chapol.c), API declarations. Live in this application: ChaCha20-Poly1305 suites are in the enabled full profile (ssl_client_full.c:51-52) and are the library's preferred suites. Quantum-safe MAC construction. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BearSSL's brssl tool name table: maps the curve name 'secp256k1' to the BR_EC_secp256k1 constant, but registers no implementation behind it — names.c:392 is { 'secp256k1', NULL, NULL, NULL } and ta.c just converts the constant to a string. The shipped library declares the curve ID but cannot perform ECDH/ECDSA on secp256k1; available in the shipped library surface only, no usable implementation. Changeable here (vendored source).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-fixture certificate generators for the application's own TLS tests: src/grpc/tests/gen-certs.sh and src/http/tests/gen-certs.sh generate P-256 (prime256v1) ECDSA self-signed certs for localhost, documented as serving ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 over BearSSL; src/ws/tests/gecerts.sh generates an RSA-4096 self-signed cert. 3650-day validity, no real chain of trust — acceptable for local tests but must never be used in production. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: POWER8-specific AES implementation (aes_pwr8_ctrcbc.c:593-594) registering CTR+CBC-MAC (CMAC-capable) block-cipher operations — used by CCM suites and the TLS key-export CBC-MAC when built for POWER8 with BR_POWER8. Hardware-conditional library surface; no application call site needed for it to ship in the library. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-224 shipped in the vendored BearSSL: API declaration (bearssl_hash.h:599) and the sha224 implementation entry in sha2small.c:254 (multihash dispatch). Not referenced by the application's TLS profiles (they use SHA-256/SHA-384); available library surface. Grover-relevant only marginally (224-bit → 112-bit quantum margin). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The central quantum-vulnerable asset of this codebase: BearSSL's complete ECDH/ECDHE implementation — EC primitive layers (ec_prime_i15/i31, curve25519/448), TLS handshake key exchange (ssl_hs_client/server.c), supported-curves logic, brssl.h tooling surface, BRE. Every application TLS session performs ECDH key agreement (P-256/P-384/P-521/Curve25519/Curve448): clients via src/ssl/iwn_brssl_poller_adapter.c:610 (gRPC at iwn_grpc_client.c:1309, WS at iwn_ws_client.c:554), server via adapter:497 (

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1) implementations shipped in BearSSL: ec_p256_m15/m31/m62/m64 dedicated implementations plus ec_secp256r1.c, used for both ECDH key agreement and ECDSA signatures; also referenced in BRE's PKCS#10 CSR generator (bre_pkcs10.c:57) and tests. Live in this application: its test certificates are P-256 ECDSA (src/grpc/tests/gen-certs.sh, src/http/tests/gen-certs.sh use prime256v1) and the servers serve ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384. Shor-vulnerable. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 implementations shipped in BearSSL: ec_c25519_i15/i31/m15/m31/m62/m64 plus ec_curve25519.c, registered in ec_all_m15/ec_all_m31/ec_default — available for ECDHE key exchange in the application's TLS sessions (client adapter:610, server adapter:497). Shor-vulnerable key agreement; migrate to ML-KEM-768 hybrid. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: brssl tool suite-name table (names.c) mapping ECDSA suites (ECDHE-ECDSA-*, ECDH-ECDSA-*) to their TLS constants — the tool's parser that lets operators select suites on the command line; shipped library surface. The application itself uses ECDSA live: P-256 ECDSA test certificates served by the HTTP/gRPC test servers with ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme; migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384 and P-521 (secp384r1/secp521r1) implementations shipped in BearSSL: ec_prime_i15/i31 generic prime-curve code plus ec_secp384r1.c/ec_secp521r1.c, used for ECDHE key exchange and ECDSA in the application's enabled TLS sessions; also referenced by BRE's PKCS#10 generator (bre_pkcs10.c:60) and tests. Shor-vulnerable; no PQ group negotiation exists in BearSSL. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Curve448 (X448/Ed448 family) name-table entries in the brssl tool (names.c:414/416) mapping the curve name to BR_EC_curve448; the implementation is shipped in the vendored library (ec_curve448.c per src/bearssl/Autark build list). Available ECDHE curve for the application's sessions. Shor-vulnerable; migrate to ML-KEM-768 hybrid. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 throughout the shipped BearSSL: suite entries in the full profiles (ssl_client_full.c:55-70 etc., live-offered by the application's adapter init_full calls at iwn_brssl_poller_adapter.c:610/497), AES implementations (aesct, aes_small/big, x86ni, pwr8), names.c table. Grover halves 128-bit to 64-bit quantum margin — CNSA 2.0 wants AES-256; not urgent, not comfortable. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM in the shipped BearSSL: gcm.c aead, GHASH implementations (ghash_ctmul/ctmul32/ctmul64/pclmul/pwr8), record layer (ssl_rec_gcm.c), engine defaults, and the GCM suites in the full profiles — the preferred family for this application's sessions (ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 is the documented/tested suite per src/grpc/tests/gen-certs.sh comment). AE mode, quantum-safe under Grover at AES-256. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 shipped in BearSSL: public API declaration (bearssl_hash.h:694) and the sha256 implementation entry in sha2small.c:293 (multihash dispatch). Live everywhere in this application's TLS: TLS 1.2 PRF (br_tls12_sha256_prf), suite PRFs, and the HMAC-DRBG that generates all session key material. Quantum-safe hash (Grover only halves preimage). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 throughout the shipped BearSSL full profiles (ssl_client_full.c:57, ssl_keyexport.c:32, server profiles) and implementations — live-offered by this application's TLS sessions via the adapter init_full calls; the application's own documented test suite is ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384. AES-256 retains a 128-bit quantum margin under Grover; meets CNSA 2.0. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD in the shipped BearSSL: suite entries at the head of the full profiles (ssl_client_full.c:53-54, ssl_server_full_ec.c:51-52) — BearSSL's preferred suites, live-offered by the application's adapter init_full calls; implementations (chacha20_ct, chacha20_sse2, poly1305) and chapol record layer. Quantum-safe AE. Changeable here.
